components.note: 欠 (open mouth, yawn) — marks mouths, wanting and owing, as in 歌 song, 欢 joy, 款 funds; 欲 is craving.
谷 (yù) gives the sound exactly: 欲 yù, also in 浴 yù and 裕 yù.
虫 (insect) — marks insects, as in 蜂 bee, 蚊 mosquito, 蜘 spider; 蜜 is what bees make: honey.
宓 (mì) gives the sound exactly: 蜜 mì, also in 密 mì.
虫 (insect) — marks insects, as in 蜜, 蚊, 蜘; 蜂 is a bee or wasp.
夆 (fēng) gives the sound exactly: 蜂 fēng, also in 峰 fēng and 锋 fēng.
大 (big) — marks size and swagger, as in 太 too, 夺; 夸 is to make something sound big, to boast.
亏 (kuī) hints at the sound: 夸 kuā is close to 垮 kuǎ and 跨 kuà.
彡 (decorative strokes) — marks patterns and adornment, as in 形 shape, 影 shadow, 彩 colour; 修 is to tidy and decorate, then repair.
攸 (yōu) is only a loose hint for xiū; 悠 yōu shares it.
礻 (spirit, from 示) — marks ritual and spirits, as in 神 god, 礼 ritual, 福 fortune, 祝 wish; 祖 is an ancestor, honoured at the altar.
且 (qiě) hints at the sound: 祖 zǔ is close to 组 zǔ, 阻 zǔ and 租 zū.
父 (father) — marks the father, as in 爸 dad, 爷 grandfather; 爹 is dad.
多 (duō) is only a loose hint for diē.
止 (foot) — a person 人 standing on tiptoe 止 to see farther; hence to aspire or plan (企图), also 企业 enterprise.
亻 (person) — marks people, as in 你, 他, 做; 佣 is a hired person.
用 (yòng) gives the sound: 佣 yōng is close, and 用 also means use.
氵 (water) — marks water, as in 河, 海, 湖; 涯 is the water's edge, hence a limit, as in 生涯 career.
厓 (yá) gives the sound exactly: 涯 yá, also in 崖 yá.
衤 (clothing) — marks garments, as in 衬, 衫, 裤; 袖 is a sleeve.
由 (yóu) hints at the sound: 袖 xiù is close to 抽 chōu and 油 yóu, which share it.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 推; 挣 is to struggle, also to earn (zhèng).
争 (zhēng) gives the sound exactly: 挣 zhēng, also in 睁 zhēng.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 扎 is to bind or prick with the hand.
寸 (inch) — a hand with a dot marking the pulse about an inch from the wrist; as a part it appears in 对, 寻, 守, 村.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 推 is to push.
隹 (zhuī) is a loose hint for tuī; 堆 duī and 谁 shéi share it.
艹 (plants) — marks grass and plants, as in 花, 草, 菜; 荐 first meant a grass fed to animals, later to offer or recommend.
马 (horse) — marks horses and riding, as in 骑 ride, 骂 scold, 驾 drive; 骚 is to stir up or annoy, as in 骚扰.
蚤 (zǎo, flea) hints at the sound: 骚 sāo is close to 搔 sāo (scratch).
羊 (yáng) hints at the sound: 养 yǎng is close, as in 样 yàng and 洋 yáng; the old form 養 added 食 food.
土 (earth) — marks ground and soil, as in 地, 城, 墙; 堪 is to bear or withstand.
甚 (shèn) is a loose hint for kān; 勘 kān shares it.
石 (stone) — marks stone and hard things, as in 破, 码, 砖; 硬 is hard.
更 (gēng) is only a loose sound hint for yìng.
巾 (cloth) — marks cloth and silk, as in 布, 带, 帽; silk was early money, hence 币 currency.
氵 (water) — marks water, as in 河, 海, 湖; 汇 is waters flowing together.
匚 (box) — the container the water gathers in, as in 区.
丁 (dīng) — a nail seen from above; as a part it sounds out 钉 dīng, 订 dìng, 顶 dǐng, 灯 dēng.
米 (rice, grain) — marks grain and food, as in 粉, 粮, 饭; 糖 is sugar, once made from grain.
唐 (táng) gives the sound exactly: 糖 táng, also in 塘 táng.
亚 (yà) — Asia; as a part it sounds out 哑 yǎ and 娅 yà.
珏 (two jades) — the same strings shape as in 琴 qín; 瑟 is a large zither, seen in 琴瑟 and foreign names.
口 (mouth) — marks speaking, as in 问 ask, 叫 call, 吃; 咨 is to consult by asking.
次 (cì) hints at the sound: 咨 zī is close to 姿 zī and 资 zī, which share it.
米 (rice, grain) — marks grain and food, as in 粉, 粮, 糖; 糊 is a paste made from grain.
胡 (hú) gives the sound exactly: 糊 hú, also in 湖 hú and 蝴 hú.
氵 (water) — marks liquids, as in 河, 汤, 油; 涂 is to smear on liquid or paint.
余 (yú) is a loose hint for tú; 途 tú shares it.
火 (fire) — marks burning and heat, as in 烧 burn, 灯 lamp, 热; 燃 is to burn.
然 (rán) gives the sound exactly: 燃 rán; 然 itself first meant burning, now it means 'so'.
火 (fire) — marks burning and heat, as in 燃, 灯, 热; 烧 is to burn or cook.
尧 (yáo) is a loose hint for shāo; 浇 jiāo and 晓 xiǎo share it.
手 (hand) — marks the hand and its actions, as in 拿, 掌 palm, 摩; 拳 is the fist, a hand curled up.
龹 (a curling shape) hints at the sound: 拳 quán is close to 卷 juǎn and 圈 quān.
幺 (tiny, faint thread) — doubled under 山 mountain: dim, hidden spots in the mountains, hence quiet and secluded.
心 (heart) — marks the mind and feelings, as in 想, 思, 意; 惑 is a doubtful, confused heart.
或 (huò) gives the sound exactly: 惑 huò.
甲 (jiǎ) — shell, armour, first of the heavenly stems; as a part it sounds out 钾 jiǎ and 胛 jiǎ.
辶 (movement) — marks walking and passing, as in 过, 进, 送; 透 is to pass through.
秀 (xiù) hints at the sound: 透 tòu is close to 诱 yòu and 锈 xiù.
心 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 想, 爱, 思; 恩 is kindness, gratitude of the heart.
因 (yīn) is only a loose sound hint for ēn.
火 (fire) — marks fire and light, as in 烧, 燃, 热; 灯 is a lamp.
丁 (dīng) hints at the sound: 灯 dēng is close.
目 (eye) — marks seeing and watching, as in 看, 眼, 睡; 督 is to oversee, to watch over.
叔 (shū) is a loose hint for dū.
兼 (jiān) hints at the sound: 廉 lián is close to 镰 lián, 嫌 xián and 谦 qiān.
氵 (water) — marks rivers and water, as in 河, 海, 江; 淇 is a river name, seen in 冰淇淋 ice cream.
其 (qí) gives the sound exactly: 淇 qí, also in 旗 qí and 棋 qí.
氵 (water) — marks water, as in 河, 海, 汤; 淋 is to pour or drench.
林 (lín) gives the sound exactly: 淋 lín.
贝 (shell, old money) — marks money and trade, as in 财, 货, 贵; 赖 is to depend on, or to default on a debt.
剌 (là) hints at the sound: 赖 lài is close, as in 癞 lài and 籁 lài.
大 (person) — a person squeezed between two smaller figures 人 on either side: to clamp or wedge in.
夷 (yí) — an old word for eastern tribes; as a part it sounds out 姨 yí, 痍 yí and 胰 yí.
七 (qī) — seven; as a part it sounds out 切 qiē (cut, with 刀 knife) and 柒 qī.
疋 (foot) — the left side is a flag shape, and a foot following it: turning with the flag, to revolve. 漩 xuán (whirlpool) shares the sound.
片 (slice, plank) — marks flat pieces and wooden boards; 牌 is a signboard, a card or a tile.
卑 (bēi) hints at the sound: 牌 pái is close to 脾 pí, which shares it.
